blocks.html: As part of the measures to minimize health risks, all major tollways will shift to cashless payments by November. In response, Robinsons Malls are offering free Autosweep RFID installation for your vehicles in a safe and convenient location!

For those traveling via Skyway/NAIA Expressway, South Luzon Expressway (SLEX), Tarlac-Pangasinan-La Union Expressway (TPLEX), and Southern Tagalog Arterial Road (STAR) Tollways – you can get your free RFID sticker tag by heading to the Autosweep booths and kiosks from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM at the following Robinsons Malls: October 9 at Robinsons Place Manila and Robinsons Galleria South; and October 30 at Robinsons Tagaytay.
With the Autosweep RFID, no need to panic while looking for loose change or your misplaced ticket right before your turn at the gate. Most importantly, you are definitely safe and protected!

For more information, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or like RobinsonsMalls on Facebook; follow @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter; and join their Viber Communities – Robinsons Malls Luzon for Luzon malls and Robinsons Malls VisMin for Visayas and Mindanao malls.
